What survives the invalidity is nevertheless real and is recorded as bounded observational state below the claim ceiling, recomputed by the Director directly from the 400 raw rows: (1) SELECTION SIGNAL, one fixture and one embedding checkpoint - max-cosine selection binds 45/52 applicable goals against 33/52 for the token-overlap null (paired family-blocked difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136, 0.3509], reproduced by the auditor) and 6/52 for a role-conditional random arm, and it is attributable to the embedding signal and NOT to the fitted gate, because A-CANDIDATE and B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX select identical mechanisms on all 52 applicable goals (result.json contingency_candidate_vs_embedding records candidate_only=0 and embedding_only=0); (3) THE DECISIVE DEFECT IS THE THRESHOLD RULE, not the feature and not the architecture - the preregistered positive-class-F1 rule selected t=0.47, only 0.0339 below the lowest applicable score, and a jointly satisfying operating point for coverage >= 0.50 and pooled false-accept <= 0.10 does exist on the same fitted feature for t >= 0.65 (coverage 0.7885, frozen-metric false-accept 0.0952) through t ~ 0.75 (coverage 0.5385, false-accept 0.0000), costing 21 to 46 percent of the applicable stratum, while the gate-only proxy reading 0.0612 at t ~ 0.58 corresponds to 0.1633 on the frozen metric and fails, so the satisfying region is materially narrower than the gate-only frontier suggests; Six instrument properties are preregistration preconditions, each of which failed as a code literal, a tautology or an unattainable target in the packet just closed. (v) The primary denominator must be declared once and identically in metric code and preregistration, and the realized split must be compared against the declared split before fitting: this packet's headline 0.9286 counted 6 DEFER rows as correct (recomputed 45/52, 35/42, 19/23) while prereg.md 6.3 excludes the deferral stratum, and the realized 29/9/14 applicable and 16/5/7 no-applicable contradicted the frozen 32/10/10 and 17/5/6, so the primary gate ran on 14 test goals instead of the 10 that were frozen.
